'''Tiger iron''' is an unremarkable, low-value, [[gem]] found in [[sedimentary layer]]s.

==In Real Life==
Tiger irons are related to the [[tigereye]] and [[cat's eye]] gems, where [[iron]] striations in the stone give the appearance of a tiger's stripes.
<gallery widths="300px" heights="200px">
Tigereisen hg.jpg|Tiger iron.
Tiger's_eye_gems.jpg|Processed and cut tiger iron gems.
</gallery>
{{D for Dwarf}}
Despite their name, tiger irons cannot be used to make [[tiger]]s or [[iron]], nor have they been documented removing tigers from wheels. It may be theoretically possible to iron a tiger with one, but field tests have so far yielded inconclusive results due to an acute shortage of surviving researchers.
